description: This file provides utility functions for setting up and managing asynchronous database connections and sessions using SQLAlchemy with an async PostgreSQL driver. It includes functions for normalizing database URLs, creating engine and session factory objects, and a FastAPI dependency for managing database sessions per request.

methods.name: str _normalize_async_database_url(database_url: str)
methods.description: Normalizes a PostgreSQL database URL to use the asyncpg driver if not already specified.

methods.name: AsyncEngine create_engine(database_url: str)
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous SQLAlchemy engine using the normalized database URL.

methods.name: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] create_session_factory(engine: AsyncEngine)
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous session factory bound to the given engine.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession,None] get_db_session(session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession])
methods.description: Asynchronous generator that provides a database session, suitable for use as a FastAPI dependency, ensuring the session is properly closed after use.
